title: the dead backpack full message and its refusals are gone
why: His ruling: no bag limit, no weight, ever (PACKCAP is 99999 since 2026-08-22). Four places still refused or dropped a gun for a full backpack and said BACKPACK FULL: the stall sale, the crate search, and the two gun swaps that push a gun into the backpack. With the cap at 99999 none of them can run. They are removed with bagDropHint (the detail under that row) and the cap locals only they read. The pack cap constant, the autoloot cull, arcadeBagFree and the bot greed test stay, because the test fixture names them.
now: A full backpack can no longer refuse a stall sale or a search, and the dead backpack full message is gone from the game.

edits.replacement: // v16.xx (cw-nobagfull), HIS RULING: no bag limit, no weight, ever. A stall sale is never refused for a full backpack, so no cap or weight is read here.

if(bagged&&bagWeight()>PACKCAP[P.pack]){ ix=G.bag.lastIndexOf('gun_'+old.id); if(ix>=0){ dropItem(ix); say('BACKPACK FULL','pick',{key:'bagfull',c:'danger',sub:(BELTDISP.name+' dropped').toUpperCase()}); BELTDISP=null; } }
